comment: E2E Rotura 1: standalone (top-level) sql_query. All config lives in `config` (connection_url, read_write permissions, setup_sql, INSERT query) with NO incoming edges. Before the fix, execute() read everything from `inputs` (empty for a root node) and failed at the 'query' check / defaulted to read_only. After the fix, execute() merges config so the INSERT runs under read_write.

config.setup_sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS e2e_standalone.items (id serial primary key, name text)
config.query: INSERT INTO e2e_standalone.items (name) VALUES ('rotura1_fixed') RETURNING id, name
